name: Matjaž Nemec-After § 29-Am 24
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 29a. Condemns the exorbitant expenses related to the maintenance, operation, cleaning, and energy consumption of the European Parliament liaison offices and Europa Experience spaces, which reflect a blatant and irresponsible waste of European taxpayers' resources; regrets this lax budgetary management, where public funds are squandered on costly and unnecessary infrastructures, without any tangible justification or real benefit for citizens;
